declarations.name: xiRestrictedWeilFloor_growth_universality
declarations.doc: Restricted-Weil floor growth universality.** The five upper-growth coordinates and seven lower-growth coordinates are exhaustive and mutually exclusive phases of one continuous floor.

declarations.name: xi_hurwitz_differential_orientation_universality_law
declarations.doc: The unconditional differential-independence factor remains present across the complete orientation certificate, so this capstone subsumes both earlier constraint-orientation product laws.

declarations.name: deningerGaussianJet_universality
declarations.doc: Finite-jet universality of the source core.** For any finite family of distinct nodes avoiding `0` and `1`, and any prescribed finite jets at those nodes, there is an endpoint-corrected Gaussian combination whose exponential polynomial realizes those jets.

declarations.name: suzukiGroundEdge_cayley_universality
declarations.doc: Ground-edge Cayley universality.** If the exact even/odd resolvent bounds make the leakage parameter vanish, every locally uniform anchored Schur limit is the universal Cayley carrier. Consequently a non-Cayley arithmetic limit requires nonvanishing excited-state leakage.

declarations.name: criticalMellinPositiveCarrier_signedPickIndexFracture_universality
declarations.doc: Critical-Mellin positive-carrier / signed-Pick index-fracture universality law.** The positive polar carrier is Pick-positive at every finite rank, while the actual signed source has unbounded finite negative Pick index.

declarations.name: thetaCusp_centerMixedOrientationRank_universality
declarations.doc: Source orientation/rank universality.** At every physical aperture the center-mixed density is pointwise positive and three-positive. Simultaneously, every finite packet of distinct physical apertures has full differential rank as an actual corrected completed-Xi prime-source family.

declarations.name: dGroup_sourceBoundary_universality
declarations.doc: The complete source-boundary universality theorem.** For a family of points of a commutative algebraic `D`-group with an arbitrary, possibly noncommuting source family: the coordinates of the points and their logarithmic coordinates have the same differential rank, and that rank is the linear rank of the boundary classes of the logarithmic source increments.

declarations.name: primeResonance_algebraicCoefficientRank_universality
declarations.doc: Prime-resonance algebraic-coefficient rank universality law.** Nonzero resonance scaling is blind not only to rational relations but to every algebraic-coefficient relation: each finite packet has full rank over `ℚ̄`. At the global level the underlying rational prime-frequency module remains non-finitely generated, so no finite phase dictionary can capture the tower.

declarations.name: primeLog_transcendental_pairIdealCensus_universality
declarations.doc: Prime-log transcendental pair-ideal census universality law.** On every finite packet of distinct primes, all support points are transcendental; the ideal shared by two multiplicity profiles is generated by the pointwise-minimum divisor; its quotient dimension is the total common multiplicity; and the radical support quotient counts exactly the labelled primes.

declarations.name: thetaCuspCassiniLikelihoodRatio_reciprocalMarkovNoGo_universality
declarations.doc: Theta-cusp Cassini likelihood-ratio / reciprocal-Markov no-go universality law.** The source-built likelihood carrier gives the exact positive-real Cassini response through a nonlinear ratio at every aperture `0 < t < 1`, while the raw reciprocal pushforward of the same carrier cannot give a global linear Markov representation.

declarations.name: thetaCuspCassiniLikelihoodCarrier_fullPhaseAtlas_universality
declarations.doc: Theta-cusp Cassini likelihood-carrier full-phase atlas universality law.** The same fixed likelihood carrier has positive density and strict Hankel blocks at every source point, gives the exact positive-real Cassini response, fails the raw reciprocal Markov identity, and places every modular cold-curvature coefficient strictly inside its order-two fluctuation cone.

declarations.name: graphicNetworkUniversality
declarations.doc: Root-zero canonical recovery supplies complete differential graphic-network universality.

exploration.name: primeSupport_resolutionThreshold_universality
exploration.doc: Prime-support resolution-threshold universality law.** 1. every support-conflict neighborhood with a center of rank at most two is claw-free; 2. rank two nevertheless identifies distinct Young shapes under every support statistic and under the complete scalar boundary germ; 3. rank three realizes an induced claw. Hence the first conflict obstruction and recovery of multiplicity information are independent: passing from two to three support ports creates the claw, while no support rank can reconstruct multiplicities discarded before support was formed.

exploration.name: xiOrientationCarrier_fracture_universality
exploration.doc: Orientation-carrier fracture universality.** The correct-polarity theta current measures the exact horizontal divisor width. Its natural positive source-core Hilbert extension cannot have the one-dimensional theta kernel as its exact radical. Meanwhile the canonical unsquared Julia defect is nonnegative at every nonnegative aperture and its first Euler-edge variation is the Ward density. Thus unsquaring preserves orientation but does not choose its polarity: the positive Julia polarization counts the charge which the continuum differential matroid cannot see.

exploration.name: dirichletDepth_two_three_zeroTransition_universality
exploration.doc: Dirichlet depth-two/three zero-transition universality law.** depth two has no zero at any positive real part; above one absolute height, every completed depth-two strip zero is critical-line aligned and simple; depth three has direct-factor zeros at arbitrarily large positive heights in the open strip. Thus the prime `3` is the first finite-aperture source capable of recurrent interior cancellation; the two-prime phase is rigid, while the three-prime phase is cofinally non-rigid.
